<bookmark mark='tray'/>Sixteen is two eights, but one hundred sixteen eggs fill fourteen trays with four left over.

<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Which numbers between four thousand five hundred sixty and four thousand five hundred eighty are divisible by eight?
